beats.visual_focus: A burning stack of paper representing redundant GPU cycles.

visual_blueprint.title: THE RE-PREFILL TRAP
visual_blueprint.sub: Why agents stall on long tasks

beats.text: The villain is the KV cache. Every new token forces a full re-process, like a librarian re-reading every book just to add a bookmark.
beats.visual_focus: A library shelf collapsing under the weight of redundant data.

beats.text: The breakthrough? Cache Engineering. We stop modifying the trajectory and start manipulating the cache state directly in-place.
beats.visual_focus: A surgical incision into a data stream.

beats.text: We use in-place tensor slicing to drop tokens and apply RoPE deltas to shift position encodings without re-calculating the prefix.

I actually understood the technical pivot in Beat 4; mentioning RoPE deltas specifically made it feel like a real engineering solution rather than marketing fluff.
